summary.text: Elizabeth Pandich is the Democratic candidate for the Florida House of Representatives, District 86, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A Cornell University graduate, she is the founder of Limelight Farm, a hunter and jumper training and sales operation, according to her campaign website.

paragraphs.text: Pandich's campaign website says she grew up in a middle-class family in New York and graduated from Cornell University with a degree in Communications while continuing to compete as a rider and develop young horses.
Ballotpedia lists her as a 2006 Cornell graduate who attended Rye Country Day School.
According to the campaign website, Pandich founded Limelight Farm in 2012, with operations in New York and Florida, and has served as an "r" judge at competitions.
The site says she met her husband, Peter, at an equestrian event and that they bought their home in South Florida in 2016.
Ballotpedia also lists Pandich as having sought the Democratic nomination for Florida's 21st Congressional District, although she did not appear on the August 18, 2026 primary ballot.
In a 2025 Ballotpedia survey for that race, she named protecting veterans and Social Security and safeguarding insurance among her priorities.
